# wally-packages

> Luau packages for Roblox game and Studio plugin development, published to the Wally registry under the morgann1/* scope.

## Docs

- [Complete reference](https://morgann1.github.io/wally-packages/llms-full.txt): the full API of every package plus all guide pages, as one markdown file

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/morgann1/wally-packages): sources, doc comments, and guide markdown live in-repo
